referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The process and material data for the production of RAP were determined through a survey of 11 asphalt plants that produce these recycling material. According to estimates, the surveyed asphalt plants produce approx. 860'000 tons of reclaimed asphalt, which corresponds to about 40% of the annually produced asphalt granulate of 2.1 million tons. A distinction was made between RAP produced in diesel-powered plants and RAP produced in electrically powered plants. This distinction arises from the fact that, in some facilities, mobile processing plants are used that are powered by diesel. The life cycle inventories of these two types of plants differ only in the energy source used. The life cycle inventories of these two types of plants differ only in the energy source applied. For this life cycle inventory, a distribution of 50% diesel-powered and 50% electrically powered plants was assumed.The machines used for material handling (wheel loaders/hydraulic excavators) are represented by the process “Building machine/RER/1 U” as well as by scaled quantities of lubricating oil based on the process “diesel, burned in building machine, with particle filter/MJ/CH” and the disposal of waste oil.
